newsitem.title: USA: D&P rates Reaseguros Alianza, unit.
newsitem.headline: D&P rates Reaseguros Alianza, unit.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Thursday it rated the claims paying ability of Reaseguros Alianza SA and its wholly owned subsidiary, Reaseguros Alianza, Panama SA as Triple B Plus.

The ratings reflect the companies' strong niche position in the Mexican and Latin American reinsurance markets, tight management of underwriting risks and currency exposure, better-than-average profitability and acceptable capital positon, Duff & Phelps said.

Offsetting factors include the company's size and the uncertainty this places on long-term competitive positioning in an increasingly global reinsurance market, heightened price competition in their markets and exposures to property catastrophe losses.
